The '''Bissillirus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Bissillirus]].

==History==
The Bissillirus system was discovered and catalogued by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] around [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]<ref name="GK" /> who were trying to map a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] through the outskirts of the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" /> Its discovery was the result of misfortune, but the scouts swiftly realized that they had uncovered a system with vast potential for trade. When the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] cut out, expedition commander [[Arnoth Draenell]] was relieved to discover that his [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] had brought him to a planetary system. A survey revealed five [[Planet/Legends|planets]], one of them habitable, later called [[Draenell's Point]]. The ship's crew went to work on the hyperdrive, while Draenell mapped and named each of the worlds. He recorded in his log that the system could serve as an excellent resupply stop for anyone traveling the [[Terr'skiar Pass]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. However, the system was then left behind and ignored for a half-century.<ref name="GK" />
